description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kamburugamuwa, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820069
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in the Kaburugamuwa North area. The content focuses on land ownership registration, title settlement, and property rights - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification category.
